RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 50

An all-male panel and selecting a male candidate with differing credentials may point to unconscious affinity bias, but regulatory experience is frequently prioritized over statistical depth for banking leadership. Without internal interview records and scoring rubrics, determining whether sex played a role is impossible.

Do not bring up the panel's gender composition casually; doing so invites immediate defensiveness and will stall productive communication. First, send a polite follow-up requesting your written feedback, specifically asking how regulatory versus technical qualifications were evaluated. Only raise the composition or allege bias if you choose to consult an employment attorney or initiate a formal grievance after evaluating their written response or in the face of ongoing stonewalling.
